blockingFindings.description: Direct inspection of the five current views still shows a plain ivory fitted jacket, broad flat lavender diagonal chest panel, sparse closures, oversized elbow diamonds and visibly faceted torso/sleeves.

The signed alternating radial pleat prototype creates stronger crease facets but the standing skirt remains a broad, low-detail flared shell rather than the short articulated fencing practice skirt visible in the concept.

Current crouch and seated renders show substantial shorts exposure and hard triangular panels beside the thighs. Current measured overskirt ray coverage on left/right upper thigh is neutral 0.7503/0.7525, crouch 0.5367/0.5424, sit 0.4373/0.4418; this is geometric prototype evidence only.
The prone image still compresses the skirt into a wide uneven fan; crouch and seated images show stiff triangular panel flares. The signed pleat displacement has not resolved the posed drape failure.
Arms-up and arm-cross images retain visible sleeve and underarm faceting; elbow diamonds remain oversized surface decals rather than restrained quilted patches.
Rear and side views remain featureless and faceted with an abrupt waist-to-skirt transition and no convincing rear adjustment or finished panel detail.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
